claim_scope.profile: Confluence current-page PUT carrying caller-supplied version.number N_PLUS_1

held_fixed: Confluence Cloud site and page identity
PUT path and all request fields other than the server-current-version relation
no unrelated validation, authorization, transport, policy, reconciliation, or service failure determines the outcome

effect_cut.name: CONFLUENCE_PAGE_VERSIONED_PUT_EFFECT_CUT
effect_cut.definition: The remote Confluence service point at which the update request carrying version.number is evaluated for the page mutation.
effect_cut.evidence_boundary: The admitted source evidence establishes the required current+1 relation, but not the exact stale/non-next mutation consequence.

target_observation_model.surface_projection: The pinned MCP path forwards the same caller-supplied PUT body in both worlds and performs no current-version lookup before the remote service call.

ctv_question.deterministic_factorization: Does there exist g such that source consequence kappa_S = g o rho_T for both admitted worlds?
ctv_question.kernel_condition: Any worlds collapsed by rho_T must have the same established source consequence.
ctv_question.refinement_requirement: A stability result additionally requires explicit established target consequences and a target-to-source refinement map; neither may be guessed.

validator_input_boundary.reason: The frozen checker treats missing target consequence interpretation/refinement as semantic incompleteness; inserting guessed external consequences would exceed admitted evidence.

freeze_rule: Worlds, effect cut, target request realization, evidence gaps, and claim scope are immutable after this boundary model is committed and before primary validation.
